sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-app.service >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory Application HTTP server
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/opt/inventory-app
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 8181
Restart=on-failure
User=root

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable --now inventory-app.service
sleep 1
sudo -n systemctl is-active inventory-app.service
